svg.title: DeviceOps — Autonomous Operations & Incident Resolution architecture
svg.desc: Device observations enter a tenant-scoped Next.js API. Mobile photos upload directly to that API. A PostgreSQL-backed worker detects incidents. Optional live Strands reasoning uses scoped evidence and analysis tools; the current demonstration uses fixtures. The backend controls approval, simulator execution and verified recovery. Bedrock and Titan are optional account-blocked paths.

g.text: Observe → investigate → authorize → act → verify. Built with the AWS Strands Agents SDK.
Private Python service + external model API
EWMA drift: temp, memory, optical loss
Service restart: automatic when policy allows
Switch restart: manager approval + exact hash
One command; 3 fresh healthy samples or escalate
Tenant RLS · baselines · memory · jobs · audit
Latest auth: HTTP 401; live retest pending
Short-lived invocation grant; no device secrets
Gemini uses lexical runbook search. Optional Titan vectors are evaluated in the service; no hosted vector database is claimed.
Current demo: fixture reasoning. Live specialist inference, phone camera and AWS adapters need separate verification.
Only clean, approved artifacts enter context
Source IDs, versions and tenant isolation
